items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: So we three... we three would do a Clark step... Streamline was an acrobat, and he taught me a little, you know, little tricks to the tree.

ctx.x: Wasn't there somebody named Streamline Harris?
Streamline Isaac Harris Isidore. All of those are his name. Isidore Isaac Harris. His full name was Streamline Isaac Harris.
He's around. Isidore. That's his full name? He's still around. Wow. Yeah, he's still around.
